These numbers are pre-existing debt, not a target. `pnpm task check:test-layers`
fails when a count rises above its baseline. When you reduce a count, run the
task with --write to lower the baseline permanently — it must never be raised
A residual entry is only legitimate when the occurrence locates an element
rather than asserting its design. Those are named in $residual below.

$residual.tests/e2e/extension-popup.spec.ts: One setViewportSize drives the responsive collapse as behaviour, not as a measurement. The three getComputedStyle reads cover the power button's hover halo: CSS `:hover` needs a real pointer, and userEvent in a Storybook play function dispatches synthetic events without setting `:hover`, so Playwright is the only harness here that can reach it.
$residual.tests/e2e/google-maps-diagnostic.spec.ts: Filters Google Maps' own controls by screen position to find the right button; there is no stable selector in a third-party UI.
$residual.tests/e2e/extension-test.helpers.ts: Reads a node's box to drive an interaction, not to assert a layout.
$residual.tests/e2e/firefox-runtime.shared.ts: Checks that an anchor is inside the viewport before acting on it.

$userDataNotes.New location: Default draft name from src/background/location-drafts.ts, not a language-pack label. Matches only as a substring of 'New locations inherit this safety limit'.
$userDataNotes.Warsaw: Example location name; also occurs in the pack's sample copy.
